title: Falkel
creator: CrossFit
description: A 25-minute AMRAP of 8 handstand push-ups, 8 box jumps to a 30/24 in box and 1 rope climb to 15 ft. Honours U.S. Army Staff Sgt. Chris Falkel, 3rd Special Forces Group, killed by small-arms fire in Deh Afghan, Afghanistan, in 2005. Lower the box and scale handstand push-ups to keep rounds under two minutes.
